item.title: At least 182 killed across Lebanon in large wave of Israeli strikes
item.summary: Attacks hit the southern suburbs of Beirut, southern Lebanon and the eastern Bekaa Valley, hours after a US-Iran ceasefire was announced.

item.title: Bowen: Ceasefire means respite for civilians, but it might not last long
item.summary: Whether or not a lasting peace deal can be reached, the war and its consequences are reshaping the Middle East, writes international editor Jeremy Bowen.

item.title: Israel backs US-Iran ceasefire but Netanyahu's war goals remain unfulfilled
item.summary: The Israeli prime minister's response to the ceasefire has been muted, in contrast to the triumphal statements from the US and Iran.

item.title: Iran Strait of Hormuz warning adds to shipping uncertainty
item.summary: Only a few vessels have crossed the strait since the US-Iran ceasefire deal, according to BBC Verify analysis.

item.title: Iran ceasefire deal gives Trump a way out of war - but at a high cost
item.summary: The path to the two-week ceasefire with Iran may have fundamentally altered the way the rest of the world views the US.

item.title: What we know about the two-week ceasefire between the US and Iran
item.summary: The provisional truce comes more than a month after the US and Israel launched coordinated attacks on Iran.

item.title: Oil prices plunge and shares jump on US-Iran ceasefire plan
item.summary: Crude prices tumbled by as much as 15% on the conditional pause but remain far higher than before the war.

item.title: One gunman killed and two injured in shooting at Israeli consulate in Istanbul
item.summary: No Israeli diplomats are currently in Turkey and the Istanbul consulate has been empty for the past two-and-a-half years.

item.title: WHO suspends Gaza medical evacuations after contractor killed by Israeli troops
item.summary: Israel's military says troops fired at a vehicle driven by the Palestinian because they believed it posed "an immediate threat".

item.title: Trump condemned over threat that Iran's 'civilisation will die'
item.summary: The UN's chief says he is "deeply troubled" by such statements, as the US president ramps up pressure on Iran to agree a deal to end the war.
